title: Turning field knowledge into resources teammates use
scope: Peer coaching, onboarding and resource creation alongside enterprise selling.
collaboration: Solution architects, SDRs, newer sellers and customer success teammates.
decision: Create reusable discovery templates and involve solution architects in the setup guides, alongside hands-on coaching for newer sellers.
context: My enterprise-selling work also included helping new teammates prepare for product, discovery and technical-evaluation conversations.
contribution: I created product training for new hires at Darktrace and Truffle Security. At Truffle, I also coached SDRs and newer sellers and built discovery and proof-of-concept resources for the sales team.
execution: At Forcepoint, Darktrace and Truffle Security, I created discovery templates and co-wrote setup guides with solution architects. At Truffle, I also helped onboard teammates across sales, solutions architecture and customer success.
evidence: The Truffle Security sales team adopted my discovery, ICP, competitive and proof-of-concept resources. My career timeline also records new-hire product training and onboarding across sales, solutions architecture and customer success.
takeaway: A useful field resource gives the next seller a clearer starting point and keeps technical setup guidance connected to the people who know it best.
reviewer: Pending Kristen Aing review of contribution, collaboration and adoption wording
